note: Channels that make programmes for children. The server reads the exported list as kids_channels.json and holds no channel name of its own, so this file is the only home of the list.
source: The broadcasters' own public names, written by hand in this repository. The same names were carried over from the compiled rule in the server that this file replaces. No third party export, capture or scrape was read.
adding: Add the broadcaster's own name as one more string. Matching trims spaces and folds case, so any capitalisation works, but the name must be the one the catalogue's network field uses or nothing will match it. Names must be unique and not blank; the export stage refuses the list otherwise. A name here only keeps a programme off adult pages. It never widens what an age tier may see: the age rule reads certificates and written profiles, never this list.
